passages.text: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second was Daniel by Abigail of Carmel; the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital; and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David had sons born to him in Hebron.
The first son was Amnon.
Amnon’s mother was Ahinoam of Jezreel.
The second son was Daniel.
Daniel’s mother was Abigail of Carmel.
The third son was Absalom.
Absalom’s mother was Maacah.
Maacah was the daughter of King Talmai of Geshur.
The fourth son was Adonijah.
Adonijah’s mother was Haggith.
The fifth son was Shephatiah.
Shephatiah’s mother was Abital.
The sixth son was Ithream.
Ithream’s mother was Eglah, David’s wife.
passages.original: וְאֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י דָויִ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֽוֹלַד־ ל֖וֹ בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀ אַמְנֹ֗ן לַאֲחִינֹ֙עַם֙ הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔ית שֵׁנִי֙ דָּנִיֵּ֔אל לַאֲבִיגַ֖יִל הַֽכַּרְמְלִֽית׃ הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ לְאַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בֶּֽן־ מַעֲכָ֔ה בַּת־ תַּלְמַ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר הָרְבִיעִ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּ֥ה בֶן־ חַגִּֽית׃ הַחֲמִישִׁ֥י שְׁפַטְיָ֖ה לַאֲבִיטָ֑ל הַשִּׁשִּׁ֥י יִתְרְעָ֖ם לְעֶגְלָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. And David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years, and these sons were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These four were born to him by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David had six sons in Hebron.
David ruled in Hebron for seven years and six months.
David ruled in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.
David had sons in Jerusalem.
Their names were Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.
Bathsheba was their mother.
Bathsheba was the daughter of Ammiel.
passages.original: שִׁשָּׁה֙ נֽוֹלַד־ ל֣וֹ בְחֶבְר֔וֹן וַיִּ֨מְלָךְ־ שָׁ֔ם שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס וְאֵ֥לֶּה נוּלְּדוּ־ ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑יִם שִׁ֠מְעָא וְשׁוֹבָ֞ב וְנָתָ֤ן וּשְׁלֹמֹה֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לְבַת־ שׁ֖וּעַ בַּת־ עַמִּיאֵֽל׃

passages.text: David’s other sons were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet—nine in all.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David had other sons.
Their names were Ibhar, Elishua, and Eliphelet.
Their names also included Nogah, Nepheg, and Japhia.
Their names also included Elishama, Eliada, and another Eliphelet.
David had nine sons in all from this group.
passages.original: וְיִבְחָ֥ר וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע וֶאֱלִיפָֽלֶט׃ וְנֹ֥גַהּ וְנֶ֖פֶג וְיָפִֽיעַ׃ וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֧ע וְאֶלְיָדָ֛ע וֶאֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט תִּשְׁעָֽה׃

passages.text: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.
passages.sermon: David had many sons.\r\nThese sons did not include the sons of his concubines.\r\nTamar was their sister.
passages.original: כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד מִלְּבַ֥ד בְּֽנֵי־ פִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וְתָמָ֥ר אֲחוֹתָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam: Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son, Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son, Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son, Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son, Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was a king of Israel.
Solomon had a son named Rehoboam.
Rehoboam had a son named Abijah.
Abijah had a son named Asa.
Asa had a son named Jehoshaphat.
Jehoshaphat had a son named Joram.
Joram had a son named Ahaziah.
Ahaziah had a son named Joash.
Joash had a son named Amaziah.
Amaziah had a son named Azariah.
Azariah had a son named Jotham.
Jotham had a son named Ahaz.
Ahaz had a son named Hezekiah.
Hezekiah had a son named Manasseh.
Manasseh had a son named Amon.
Amon had a son named Josiah.
passages.original: וּבֶן־ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה רְחַבְעָ֑ם אֲבִיָּ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖וֹ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנֽוֹ׃ יוֹרָ֥ם בְּנ֛וֹ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ יוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּנֽוֹ׃ אֲמַצְיָ֧הוּ בְנ֛וֹ עֲזַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנֽוֹ׃ אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֛וֹ חִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃ אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The sons of Josiah: Johanan was the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was a king of Judah.
Josiah had four sons.
Johanan was Josiah’s first son.
Jehoiakim was Josiah’s second son.
Zedekiah was Josiah’s third son.
Shallum was Josiah’s fourth son.
passages.original: וּבְנֵי֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יוֹחָנָ֔ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖י יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ הָרְבִיעִ֖י שַׁלּֽוּם׃

passages.text: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim was a king of Judah.
Jehoiakim had a son named Jeconiah.
Jeconiah was Jehoiakim’s son.
Jehoiakim also had a son named Zedekiah.
Zedekiah was Jehoiakim’s son.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים יְכָנְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The descendants of Jeconiah the captive: Shealtiel his son, Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
passages.sermon:
Jeconiah was a king of Judah.
People called him "the captive."
Jeconiah had several descendants.
Shealtiel was his son.
Malchiram was also his descendant.
Pedaiah was another descendant of Jeconiah.
Shenazzar was a descendant of Jeconiah.
Jekamiah was a descendant of Jeconiah.
Hoshama was a descendant of Jeconiah.
Nedabiah was a descendant of Jeconiah.
passages.original: וּבְנֵי֙ יְכָנְיָ֣ה אַסִּ֔ר שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל בְּנֽוֹ׃ וּמַלְכִּירָ֥ם וּפְדָיָ֖ה וְשֶׁנְאַצַּ֑ר יְקַמְיָ֥ה הוֹשָׁמָ֖ע וּנְדַבְיָֽה׃

passages.text: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The children of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, their sister Shelomith, and five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
passages.sermon:
Pedaiah had two sons.
Their names were Zerubbabel and Shimei.
Zerubbabel had several children.
His sons were Meshullam and Hananiah.
He had a daughter named Shelomith.
Zerubbabel also had five other children.
Their names were Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י פְדָיָ֔ה זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל וְשִׁמְעִ֑י וּבֶן־ זְרֻבָּבֶל֙ מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם וַחֲנַנְיָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹמִ֖ית אֲחוֹתָֽם׃ וַחֲשֻׁבָ֡ה וָ֠אֹהֶל וּבֶרֶכְיָ֧ה וַֽחֲסַדְיָ֛ה י֥וּשַׁב חֶ֖סֶד חָמֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah, and of Shecaniah.
passages.sermon:
Hananiah was a descendant of Jeconiah the captive.
Hananiah had two sons.
Their names were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah.
There were also descendants from Hananiah through other families.
These families were the family of Rephaiah, the family of Arnan, the family of Obadiah, and the family of Shecaniah.
passages.original: וּבֶן־ חֲנַנְיָ֖ה פְּלַטְיָ֣ה וִישַֽׁעְיָ֑ה בְּנֵ֤י רְפָיָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַרְנָ֔ן בְּנֵ֥י עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָֽה׃ס

passages.text: The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
passages.sermon:
Shecaniah had a son named Shemaiah.
Shemaiah had five sons.
Their names were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
Shecaniah’s family included six descendants: Shemaiah, Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה שְׁמַעְיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֣י שְׁמַעְיָ֗ה חַטּ֡וּשׁ וְ֠יִגְאָל וּבָרִ֧יחַ וּנְעַרְיָ֛ה וְשָׁפָ֖ט שִׁשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam—three in all.
passages.sermon: Neariah had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
passages.original: וּבֶן־ נְעַרְיָ֗ה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֧י וְחִזְקִיָּ֛ה וְעַזְרִיקָ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.
passages.sermon: Elioenai had seven sons.\r\nTheir names were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֗י הֹדַיְוָהוּ וְאֶלְיָשִׁ֡יב וּפְלָיָ֡ה וְ֠עַקּוּב וְיוֹחָנָ֧ן וּדְלָיָ֛ה וַעֲנָ֖נִי שִׁבְעָֽה׃ס
